answer.exemplar: By negotiating treaties that recognized postwar borders and improved East-West communication, Ostpolitik reduced tensions and laid groundwork for broader Cold War détente.

questions.explanation: Ostpolitik's treaties reduced tensions and supported détente; it improved East-West communication.

questions.topic: A government overthrown by its own officers

stimulus.body: After the junta fell in 1974, Greece restored parliamentary democracy and later joined the European Community. The transition showed how military failure could open space for democratic renewal.

questions.stem: What followed the fall of the Greek junta?
questions.explanation: The source says democracy was restored; permanent military rule, Turkish annexation, or abolished elections are not supported.
